content.short: Bridging the gap between NFT's and the fashion industry.
content.description:
Soho Kids is a project focused on bridging fashion design, from haute couture to street style, into the NFT and Cardano world in the form of a fun and colorful PFP collection.

Our long term vision is to continue building these connections and be the first-mover to work with this industry, from the smaller designers with their own personal collections to the huge fashion houses that we all know.
